title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the 2026 UN Climate Change Conference in Antalya, Türkiye (COP31)
part_text: – having regard to the recently amended EU Climate Law4, introducing a binding EU‑wide 2040 climate target of a 90 % net reduction in GHG emissions compared to 1990 levels, with up to 5 % achievable via high-quality international carbon credits from 2036 onwards, based on a technology-neutral approach, \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 4 Regulation (EU) 2026/667 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 11 March 2026 amending Regulation (EU) 2021/1119 as regards the setting of a Union intermediate climate target for 2040 (OJ L, 2026/667, 18.3.2026, ELI: ).
